cd /workspace && LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/workspace/native PYTHONPATH=/workspace/vendor:/workspace/submission timeout 300 python3 -c "
import sys, random
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tmp')
import planner
from gen2 import gen_case
rng = random.Random(0)
case = gen_case(rng, 64, 32, 8, 4)
J=len(case['windows'])
info=[]
orig_aug = planner._augment
def aug(net,cap,path):
    dt=net.dist[net.TT]
    mx=max(abs(x) for x in net.pi)
    info.append((dt,mx))
    return orig_aug(net,cap,path)
planner._augment=aug
res=planner.solve_epoch(case)
for i,(dt,mx) in enumerate(info[:20]): print(i, 'dt', dt, 'maxabs pi', mx)
print('...')
print('last', info[-3:])
print('W', 1+J*case['slots'][-1][0])
